settlements.name: Fanatics Handling Fee

settlements.name: Labcorp / AMCA Patient Data Breach

settlements.name: Circle K Data Incident
settlements.eligibility: Received a Circle K data-incident notice.

settlements.name: Disney YouTube TV & DirecTV Stream Pricing
settlements.eligibility: Subscribed to YouTube TV or DirecTV Stream during the class period.

settlements.name: STIIIZY Data Breach
settlements.eligibility: STIIIZY customer whose data was exposed in the 2024 breach.

settlements.name: Google AdMob Children's Data
settlements.eligibility: Parent of a child whose data was collected via AdMob in kids' apps.

settlements.name: Serviceaide / Catholic Health Breach
settlements.eligibility: Received a Serviceaide or Catholic Health breach notice.

settlements.name: Lands' End Data Breach
settlements.eligibility: Lands' End customer affected by the December 2024 breach. Up to $5,000 with documented losses.

settlements.name: ApolloMD data breach
settlements.eligibility: Affected by the 2025 breach

settlements.name: O’Reilly Automotive spam text messages
settlements.eligibility: The class action settlement benefits consumers in the United States whose telephone numbers were registered on the National Do Not Call Registry for at least 30 days and who received more than one text message from or on behalf of O’Reilly Automotive within a 12-month period after the telephone number was reassigned to them.

settlements.name: Atrium Health data privacy
settlements.eligibility: The class action settlement benefits individuals who had a MyAtriumHealth or MyCarolinas patient portal account between Jan. 1, 2015, and April 10, 2024.

settlements.name: Tesla idle fees
settlements.eligibility: Purchased a Tesla vehicle described in Tesla's Motor Vehicle Purchase Agreement as “Supercharger Enabled,” “Supercharger Hardware,” or “Supercharger Hardware & Access” before December 16, 2016.

settlements.name: 700Credit data breach
settlements.eligibility: The class action settlement benefits individuals who received a data breach notice from 700Credit informing them that their private information may have been compromised in a data breach on Oct. 25, 2025.

settlements.name: Central Transport sex discrimination settlement
settlements.eligibility: The Central Transport settlement benefits women who sought employment as a truck driver with Central Transport by submitting a paper or electronic application at any terminal or facility nationwide from Jan. 1, 2016, to the present, who held a Class A commercial driver’s license at the time of their application, and who were denied employment as a truck driver by Central Transport at least once during that period.

settlements.name: NAR real estate commission
settlements.eligibility: The class action settlement benefits consumers who purchased a home that was listed on a multiple listing service where a commission was paid to any brokerage in connection with the transaction during the class periods.

settlements.name: Travelers Insurance New Mexico UIM coverage
settlements.eligibility: The Travelers Insurance settlement benefits New Mexico policyholders who had UIM coverage with Travelers Insurance between Jan. 1, 2015, and Aug. 16, 2022.

settlements.name: Night US Brooklyn Bedding
settlements.eligibility: The class action settlement benefits consumers who, while physically in California or as residents of California, purchased one or more mattresses advertised at a discount from leesa.com between July 28, 2019, and March 11, 2024; brooklynbedding.com between Sept. 5, 2020, and March 31, 2024; helixsleep.com between Oct. 2, 2020, and March 31, 2024; or bearmattress.com between June 4, 2021, and April 1, 2024.

settlements.name: Chantix nitrosamine
settlements.eligibility: The class action settlement benefits consumers and third-party payors who paid any amount of money for retail purchases of Chantix in the United States and its territories from Sept. 29, 2015, through Sept. 17, 2021.

settlements.name: Farmers Insurance TCPA
settlements.eligibility: Received two or more telemarketing calls or texts from Farmers Insurance during the covered period, on a cell phone number listed on the National Do Not Call Registry and included in the litigation data list.

settlements.name: YouTube TV automatic renewal
settlements.eligibility: The class action settlement benefits California residents who, between Feb. 1, 2017, and Oct. 29, 2021, enrolled in and paid for at least one renewal term of a YouTube TV subscription purchased via YouTube billing for personal, family or household purposes, excluding those who enrolled in YouTube TV through iOS-based mobile applications from Apple’s App Store, YouTube TV subscriptions that were canceled during a free trial and YouTube TV subscriptions that were fully refunded by the defendants.

settlements.name: Payactiv data breach
settlements.eligibility: The Payactiv settlement benefits individuals who received a data breach notification from Payactiv informing them that their information may have been compromised in a data incident in April 2025.

settlements.name: ZOLL Medical Corp. data breach
settlements.eligibility: The ZOLL Medical settlement benefits consumers who received a data breach notice from ZOLL Medical Corp. informing them that their information may have been compromised in a January 2023 data security incident.

settlements.name: Oppenheimer & Co. ABDP cash sweep
settlements.eligibility: The class action settlement benefits Oppenheimer and Oppenheimer Asset Management customers who participated in the Advantage Bank Deposit Program from March 17, 2022, through May 22, 2026.

settlements.name: Hartford premium tax charges
settlements.eligibility: The class action settlement benefits individuals who own or owned a universal or variable universal life insurance policy issued by Talcott Resolution Life & Annuity Insurance or Talcott Resolution Life Insurance with policy terms stating the premium tax charge depends on the policyholder’s state or municipality of residence.

settlements.name: RealPage antitrust
settlements.eligibility: The RealPage class action settlement benefits consumers who paid rent on at least one multifamily residential real estate lease directly to any owner, manager or owner-operator on a property subject to a license for RealPage’s Revenue Management Solutions between Oct. 18, 2018, and Nov. 21, 2025.

settlements.name: Strides testosterone gel
settlements.eligibility: The class action settlement benefits consumers who purchased Strides testosterone gel between June 1, 2022, and July 31, 2025.

settlements.name: Anthem denied benefits
settlements.eligibility: The class action settlement benefits individuals identified by Anthem who received proton beam radiation therapy for prostate cancer but whose treatments were not covered by insurance.

settlements.name: The Money Source robocalls
settlements.eligibility: The class action settlement benefits consumers who received a call from The Money Source (TMS) between Feb. 6, 2019, and May 7, 2025, directed to a number assigned to a cellular telephone service in which TMS used an artificial or prerecorded voice after the called party requested that TMS stop calling them.

settlements.name: Ernst & Young, Bank of America MOVEit data breach
settlements.eligibility: The settlement benefits individuals whose personal information was included in the files affected by the MOVEit security incident in May 2023.
settlements.payout: Up to $12,500 in reimbursement for losses or a $100 cash payment, plus two years of credit monitoring and identity theft protection services

settlements.name: Volkswagen Atlas water pump
settlements.eligibility: The class action settlement benefits consumers who purchased or leased certain 2018-2022 Volkswagen Atlas or Atlas Cross Sport vehicles equipped with a 3.6-liter engine.

settlements.name: Total Vision data breach
settlements.eligibility: The class action settlement benefits all individuals who received a data breach notification from Total Vision regarding a data security incident that occurred on Oct. 30, 2020.

settlements.name: Healthcare Services Group data breach
settlements.eligibility: The settlement benefits individuals who received a notice from Healthcare Services Group regarding potential impact from the data breach or who were otherwise determined to have potentially had their private information impacted by the data breach.

settlements.name: USAA Michigan auto insurance
settlements.eligibility: The USAA settlement benefits Michigan USAA policyholders who made a first-party claim between Jan. 27, 2015, and March 11, 2026

settlements.name: Pierce County Library System data breach
settlements.eligibility: The class action settlement benefits all current and former employees and their family members as well as current and former contractors who received notice from PCLS that their personal information may have been affected by the data incident.

settlements.name: LifeStance Health Group website tracking
settlements.eligibility: Subclass 1: LifeStance members who booked at least one session through LifeStance’s online booking tool, accessed through LifeStance’s public website lifestance.com, between March 1, 2020, and April 30, 2023. Subclass 2: All other members of LifeStance’s total patient population between March 1, 2020, and April 30, 2023, not including those in Subclass 1.

settlements.name: Mount Sinai Medical Center data breach
settlements.eligibility: The Mount Sinai Medical Center settlement benefits individuals who accessed Mount Sinai Medical Center of Florida’s website or patient portal between June 10, 2021, and Sept. 18, 2025.

settlements.name: Guitar Center wage and hour violations
settlements.eligibility: The settlement benefits non-exempt Guitar Center employees who worked for the company between Jan. 11, 2020, and July 11, 2025. The PAGA portion of the settlement benefits non-exempt Guitar Center employees who worked for the company between Jan. 11, 2022, and July 11, 2025.

settlements.name: Equifax credit reporting
settlements.eligibility: Consumers identified by Equifax as having been mailed a Duplicate Reporting Letter in August or September 2022.

settlements.name: Serviceaide data breach
settlements.eligibility: The settlement benefits individuals whose personal information was compromised in the Serviceaide data breach that occurred between Sept. 19 and Nov. 5, 2024.

settlements.name: FitOn video privacy
settlements.eligibility: Individuals who had a FitOn account and accessed at least one video on the FitOn video platform between Oct. 22, 2022, and May 29, 2026.

settlements.name: Disney antitrust
settlements.eligibility: YouTube TV class: Anyone who purchased a YouTube TV subscription from April 1, 2019, through March 31, 2026. DirecTV Stream class: Anyone who purchased a DirecTV streaming live pay TV subscription from April 1, 2019, through March 31, 2026. This includes DirecTV Stream, DirecTV Now and AT&T TV Now subscriptions.

settlements.name: Las Vegas Grand Prix tickets
settlements.eligibility: The class action settlement benefits individuals and entities who attended the Nov. 16, 2023, race events using an eligible Thursday-only or three-day ticket purchased directly from Las Vegas Grand Prix or transferred from the original purchaser. Class members must have scanned their ticket for entry before midnight that day.

settlements.name: Call-On-Doc tracking pixels
settlements.eligibility: The class action settlement benefits California residents who created an account with Call-On-Doc on or after Nov. 7, 2023, or who were registered users with Call-On-Doc and started to book appointments for medical care on or after Nov. 7, 2021.

settlements.name: Flo period tracker
settlements.eligibility: You are a member of the nationwide class if you used the Flo app in the United States between Nov. 1, 2016, and Feb. 28, 2019, and you entered menstruation and/or pregnancy information into the Flo app during that time. You are a member of the California subclass if you used the Flo app in California between Nov. 1, 2016, and Feb. 28, 2019, you entered menstruation and/or pregnancy information into the Flo app during that time and you resided in California during that time.
